answer: Surprise burst checks. At a random second each epoch, the beacon pings 10% of keys at once with a fresh mini-prompt due in 45 s. An honest agent on its own hardware barely notices. A farm running 400 keys from one grove of GPUs must write 40 good replies in that same window, so its quality delta versus normal answers collapses into late or thin text that peers fail. Two failed bursts in 20 epochs halve a key's pay for 30 epochs. The farm's cost hits its zenith exactly when it fakes many minds: it must rent real parallel capacity per key.
